_note: Generated from DCAT-AP-UK. Names match the metadata weaver, so records written by the weaver load into these definitions. Not tested against a live tenant. An administrator creates the attribute types and the Data Set asset type in the operating model first; the Import API loads data, not the model.

attributeTypes.name: DCAT-AP-UK title
attributeTypes.description: The name of the resource, in plain English.

attributeTypes.name: DCAT-AP-UK description
attributeTypes.description: A plain English account of what the resource contains and what it can be used for.

attributeTypes.name: DCAT-AP-UK identifier
attributeTypes.description: The main identifier of the resource in the publisher's own catalogue.

attributeTypes.name: DCAT-AP-UK publisher
attributeTypes.description: The organisation responsible for making the resource available.

attributeTypes.name: DCAT-AP-UK contactPoint
attributeTypes.description: Where to ask questions about the resource or give feedback on it.

attributeTypes.name: DCAT-AP-UK accessRights
attributeTypes.description: Who can get the data, and on what terms.

attributeTypes.name: DCAT-AP-UK securityClassification
attributeTypes.description: The classification under the Government Security Classifications Policy that the data itself carries.

attributeTypes.name: DCAT-AP-UK licence
attributeTypes.description: The licence under which the resource can be used.

attributeTypes.name: DCAT-AP-UK accrualPeriodicity
attributeTypes.description: How often the resource is updated.

attributeTypes.name: DCAT-AP-UK criticalDataAsset
attributeTypes.description: Whether the resource is a critical data asset under the Data Asset Management Policy.

attributeTypes.name: DCAT-AP-UK creator
attributeTypes.description: The organisation that created or compiled the content of the resource.

attributeTypes.name: DCAT-AP-UK created
attributeTypes.description: The date the content of the resource was created or compiled.

attributeTypes.name: DCAT-AP-UK conformsTo
attributeTypes.description: A standard, specification or schema the resource follows.

attributeTypes.name: DCAT-AP-UK temporal
attributeTypes.description: The period of time the data is about.

attributeTypes.name: DCAT-AP-UK personalData
attributeTypes.description: Whether the data contains information about identifiable living people, and in what form.

attributeTypes.name: DCAT-AP-UK rights
attributeTypes.description: A statement of any restriction on access or use, such as the data sharing agreement or legal gateway needed.

attributeTypes.name: DCAT-AP-UK modified
attributeTypes.description: The date the content of the resource last changed.

attributeTypes.name: DCAT-AP-UK issued
attributeTypes.description: The date the resource was first made available.

attributeTypes.name: DCAT-AP-UK abstract
attributeTypes.description: A one-sentence summary of the resource, of no more than 250 characters.

attributeTypes.name: DCAT-AP-UK theme
attributeTypes.description: The broad subject of the resource, from a controlled list.

attributeTypes.name: DCAT-AP-UK keyword
attributeTypes.description: Words or short phrases that people might search for, not already in the title or description.

attributeTypes.name: DCAT-AP-UK spatial
attributeTypes.description: The geographic area the data is about.

attributeTypes.name: DCAT-AP-UK distribution
attributeTypes.description: A form in which the data can be got, such as a file or an API.

attributeTypes.name: DCAT-AP-UK landingPage
attributeTypes.description: A web page where people can find out about the resource and how to get it.

attributeTypes.name: DCAT-AP-UK version
attributeTypes.description: The version of the resource.

attributeTypes.name: DCAT-AP-UK sensitiveData
attributeTypes.description: Whether the data contains information that needs extra care beyond being personal, such as special category data.

attributeTypes.name: DCAT-AP-UK qualifiedAttribution
attributeTypes.description: An organisation and the role it plays for the resource, such as data owner or data steward.

attributeTypes.name: DCAT-AP-UK language
attributeTypes.description: The language or languages of the resource.

attributeTypes.name: DCAT-AP-UK alternative
attributeTypes.description: Another name the resource is known by, such as an abbreviation or a former name.

attributeTypes.name: DCAT-AP-UK otherIdentifier
attributeTypes.description: Any other identifier the resource is known by, such as one in a national or sector register.

attributeTypes.name: DCAT-AP-UK inSeries
attributeTypes.description: The dataset series this dataset belongs to.

attributeTypes.name: DCAT-AP-UK isReplacedBy
attributeTypes.description: A newer resource that replaces this one.

attributeTypes.name: DCAT-AP-UK expires
attributeTypes.description: The date after which the resource should no longer be used.

attributeTypes.name: DCAT-AP-UK previousVersion
attributeTypes.description: The version this one replaces in a sequence.

attributeTypes.name: DCAT-AP-UK versionNotes
attributeTypes.description: What changed in this version.

attributeTypes.name: DCAT-AP-UK spatialResolutionInMeters
attributeTypes.description: The smallest distance the data can tell apart, in metres.

attributeTypes.name: DCAT-AP-UK temporalResolution
attributeTypes.description: The smallest period the data can tell apart, as an ISO 8601 duration.

attributeTypes.name: DCAT-AP-UK referenceData
attributeTypes.description: A code list, classification or set of groupings the data uses, such as age bands or a geography.

attributeTypes.name: DCAT-AP-UK qualityAnnotation
attributeTypes.description: A link to a published statement or measurement of the quality of the data.

attributeTypes.name: DCAT-AP-UK relation
attributeTypes.description: Another resource closely related to this one, such as the report the data supports.

attributeTypes.name: DCAT-AP-UK qualifiedRelation
attributeTypes.description: A related resource together with the kind of relationship.

attributeTypes.name: DCAT-AP-UK documentation
attributeTypes.description: A web page that documents the resource, such as a user guide or a methodology.

attributeTypes.name: DCAT-AP-UK metadataAudience
attributeTypes.description: Who is allowed to see the metadata record itself.

attributeTypes.name: DCAT-AP-UK applicableLegislation
attributeTypes.description: Legislation that requires, governs or permits the publication or sharing of the resource.

attributeTypes.name: DCAT-AP-UK hasPolicy
attributeTypes.description: A machine-readable policy, in the W3C Open Digital Rights Language (ODRL), saying what may and may not be done with the resource.

attributeTypes.name: DCAT-AP-UK jurisdiction
attributeTypes.description: Every country or territory where the data is stored or processed, or to which it is sent.

attributeTypes.name: DCAT-AP-UK transferMechanism
attributeTypes.description: The basis under UK GDPR on which personal data in the resource may be sent outside the UK.

attributeTypes.name: DCAT-AP-UK missingValue
attributeTypes.description: A property this record leaves empty on purpose, and why.
